Initial release of the RAG Engineering skill — a comprehensive guide for building, optimizing, and debugging production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

- Introduces a structured methodology covering RAG architecture assessment, data ingestion, preprocessing, and chunking.
- Provides health check metrics and decision trees for system design choices.
- Includes step-by-step data processing pipelines and extraction strategies by document type.
- Offers detailed chunking methods, decision guides, and quality benchmarks.
- Supplies practical checklists for cleaning and metadata enrichment.
- Designed to support both prototyping and scalable production use-cases.
